poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaun si hai — united opposition, Google ka school AI band, ya Maryam ka Rs5bn notice?
options: 🏛️ United opposition — KP emergency ke baad ek awaaz
🎓 Google ne bachon ka AI band kiya — school control wapas
⚖️ Maryam ka Rs5bn notice — saboot lao warna adalat
⚽ SAFF mein Pak vs India — Thursday ko bara match

https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/scitech/.what: Google ne K-12 student accounts par Gemini aur Search ke AI features default par band kar diye — ab school admin khud on karega, tab hi bachon ko milega.
https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/scitech/.why: 150 million students Google Classroom use karte hain, aur senators ne poocha tha ke bachon ke devices par AI default on kyun hai jabke schools abhi policy par behas kar rahe hain.
https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/scitech/.next: Dekhna ye hai ke US ke baad dunya bhar mein rollout kab hota hai, aur kya doosri companies (Microsoft, OpenAI) bhi school accounts par default off karengi.
https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/scitech/.take: Meri take: ye faisla dair se aaya lekin sahi aaya. Bachon par AI thopna aur unhe AI ke baare mein sikhana do alag cheezein hain. Lekin Google ka ye kehna ke 'AI ban karo to Search bhi gaya' ek warning bhi hai — jab ek company ke paas classroom aur search dono hon, to us ki 'choice' bhi us ki shartein par milti hai.

https://startupfortune.com/tencent-launc.what: Tencent ka Hy4 ab screen dekh sakta hai aur computer khud operate kar sakta hai — 770B parameters, Blender/CAD jaise professional tools par trained, API se live.
https://startupfortune.com/tencent-launc.why: AI ki agle stage sirf jawab dena nahi, kaam karna hai — jo model screen par click kar sakta hai, wo office ka kaam seedha kar sakta hai, bina insaan ke beech mein.
https://startupfortune.com/tencent-launc.next: Weights kab release honge ye sab se bara sawal hai — jab tak weights nahi, koi bahar wala is ke benchmarks khud verify nahi kar sakta.
https://startupfortune.com/tencent-launc.take: Meri take: Hy4 ki kahani doosri hai — ek taraf computer-use ka darwaza khul gaya, doosri taraf Tencent ne apna open playbook khud tor diya. Jab company apne weights chhupaye, to samajh jao ke model ab sirf research nahi, hathiyar ban gaya hai. Aur hallucination 5.45% bhi tab maano jab koi bahar wala khud test kare.

https://interestingengineering.com/ai-ro.what: Anthropic ne Claude ke saath bacteria se mutaliq vault particle ki pehli 3D structure banayi — 96 copies ka L05 protein shell, 34 ghante mein pehla model, purification 3 din se 90 minute par.
https://interestingengineering.com/ai-ro.why: Vaults 40 saal se mystery hain — insan ke cells mein sab se bara protein structure, lekin kaam maloom nahi. Bacteria mein milne se scientists ko ek sasta, simple system mil gaya hai study ke liye.
https://interestingengineering.com/ai-ro.next: BioRxiv preprint aur data release ke baad independent labs is structure ko verify karenge — aur asal sawal (vault karta kya hai) abhi bhi khula hai.
https://interestingengineering.com/ai-ro.take: Meri take: ye khabar is liye khaas hai ke is mein AI ki tareef ke saath us ki ghalti bhi likhi hai — ek ghalat map, do haftay ki delay. Jo AI lab apni ghaltiyan bhi report kare, us par bharosa zyada banta hai. Aur ye bhi yaad rakhna: AI ne structure dhoonda hai, us ka matlab abhi bhi insaan ko dhoondna hai.

https://www.tradingview.com/news/busines.what: CrowdStrike ka Red Tempest AI ab customer ke system par khud hacker ban kar hamla karta hai — kamzoriyon ko chain kar ke critical assets tak pahuncha, phir fix karke dobara test karta hai.
https://www.tradingview.com/news/busines.why: Ab hamlaawar bhi AI agents chala rahe hain — ek agent ne sirf ek vulnerability se 726 databases nikaal liye. Saal mein ek baar ka pen test is speed ka muqabla nahi kar sakta.
https://www.tradingview.com/news/busines.next: Early access se general availability tak ye batayega ke automated red teaming ek premium feature rehta hai ya har company ki basic security ban jata hai.
https://www.tradingview.com/news/busines.take: Meri take: ye wo waqt hai jab defender ko attacker ki naqal karni par rahi hai — aur ye theek hai. Lekin ek sawal mat bhoolo: jo AI aap ke system par hamla karna seekh rahi hai, wo seekh kahan ja rahi hai? Offensive AI ka data bhi utna hi sensitive hai jitna wo system jis ki hifazat ho rahi hai.

https://www.unite.ai/salesforce-agrees-t.what: Salesforce ne Cresta khareedne ka agreement kiya — voice AI agents jo customer calls end-to-end handle karte hain, plus live human agents ko real-time coaching.
https://www.unite.ai/salesforce-agrees-t.why: Chat to AI ne jeet liya, ab bari phone ki hai — customer service ka sab se mushkil channel voice hai, aur jo isay jeetega wo enterprise AI ka agla darwaza kholega.
https://www.unite.ai/salesforce-agrees-t.next: Deal Feb-Apr 2027 mein close hogi (regulatory approval ke baad) — tab pata chalega ke Cresta Service Cloud mein ghul jata hai ya apni pehchan rakhta hai.
https://www.unite.ai/salesforce-agrees-t.take: Meri take: $2.7 billion ki reported qeemat batati hai ke voice AI ab side feature nahi, core business hai. Lekin Pakistani users ke liye asal sawal ye hai: jab aap call karenge to samne insaan hoga ya AI? Aur agar AI hai to kya aap ko bataya jayega? Transparency is deal ki sab se bara test hogi.

https://forklog.com/en/china-to-fast-tra.what: China ne ek comprehensive AI law ki tayyari tez kar di — poori lifecycle par safety standards, risk disclosure aur incident reporting, DeepSeek/Moonshot/Alibaba scope mein.
https://forklog.com/en/china-to-fast-tra.why: China ke paas ab 700 million se zyada AI users hain — jab itne log ek technology use karein, to qanoon banana option nahi, zaroorat ban jata hai.
https://forklog.com/en/china-to-fast-tra.next: Draft text aur deadline abhi nahi aayi — asal test ye hoga ke qanoon innovation ko rokta hai ya sirf guardrail lagata hai.
https://forklog.com/en/china-to-fast-tra.take: Meri take: dilchasp baat ye hai ke China apne hi champions ko regulate kar raha hai — DeepSeek aur Alibaba ko bhi wahi rules jinhay wo dunya par lagana chahta hai. Jo mulk AI ke rules pehle likhega, wo agle 10 saal ki race ki shakal bhi tay karega. Pakistan ke liye sabak: rules tab banao jab technology aaye, us ke baad nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2042114/united.what: Opposition leaders Fazlur Rehman ke ghar jama hue — alliance aur parliamentary coordination mazboot karne, committees banane aur multiparty conference ki mashawarat par ittefaq.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042114/united.why: KP mein emergency aur governor's rule ke baad opposition ke paas parliament ke andar ek awaaz banana ke ilawa koi rasta nahi bacha — bikhri hui opposition ka koi wazan nahi hota.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042114/united.next: MPC ki date aur Charter of Democracy ka draft batayega ke ye ittehad sirf mulaqat hai ya koi joint roadmap bhi ban raha hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042114/united.take: Meri take: opposition ka ek kamre mein baithna khabar hai, lekin ye pehli dafa nahi ho raha. Asal test ye hai ke kya ye log apne ikhtilafat (jo committees ko diye gaye hain) hal kar sakte hain — kyun ke Pakistan mein opposition ittehad aksar ek photo-op tak mehdood rehta hai, aur photo-op se koi hukumat nahi girti.

https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/inte.what: Peshawar High Court ne Afridi aur doosre PTI leaders ki detention ke khilaf petitions larger bench ko refer kar di — leaders 11 October se laapata, 200+ MPO cases darj.
https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/inte.why: Jab ek former CM ki whereabouts par adalat ko bhi report na mile, to ye sirf ek shakhs ka case nahi rehta — ye adalat ke apne orders ki implementation ka sawal ban jata hai.
https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/inte.next: Larger bench ka faisla aur government ki report batayengi ke ye leaders protective custody mein hain ya MPO detention mein — aur kab tak.
https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/inte.take: Meri take: sab se pareshan kun line ye hai ke adalat ki 10 din ki deadline guzar gayi aur report phir bhi nahi aayi. Adalat ka hukm agar sirf kagaz par rahe to wo adalat nahi, mashwara ban jata hai. Is case par nazar rakhna — is ka natija KP ke har detention case ke liye precedent banega.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041984.what: SAFF Championship aaj Dhaka mein shuru — Pakistan ka pehla match Thursday ko India se, Solano ka target semi-final, diaspora players shuru mein nahi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041984.why: Pakistan football ke liye ye tournament sirf trophy nahi — ye test hai ke local talent, bina overseas players ke, regional level par kahan khara hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041984.next: India aur Maldives ke khilaf do matches hi decide karenge ke Pakistan last four mein jata hai ya group stage se wapas aata hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041984.take: Meri take: Solano ka 'no excuses' kehna achha lagta hai, lekin sach ye hai ke bina diaspora players ke team kamzor zaroor hai. Phir bhi — India ke khilaf match mein motivation ki kami nahi hoti. Agar local boys is pressure mein perform kar gaye, to ye Pakistan football ke liye sirf jeet nahi, ek naya confidence hoga.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041988.what: Shaheens ka Asia Cup Rising Stars squad announce — captain Abdul Samad, Maaz Sadaqat aur Hasan Nawaz bhi shamil, title defence Qatar mein 20 November se.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041988.why: Rising Stars jaise tournaments hi wo seedhi hai jahan se agle senior players aate hain — Maaz aur Hasan is ki zinda misaal hain, senior side mein jagah bana chuke.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041988.next: India A ke khilaf 22 November ka match group ka sab se bara test hoga — aur final 29 November ko.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041988.take: Meri take: Shaheens ka system kaam kar raha hai — jo larke yahan chamakte hain, wo seedha senior team mein jate hain. Lekin ye bhi yaad rakhna ke Maaz jese players ko senior aur Shaheens dono mein khilana workload ka masla ban sakta hai. Trophy jeetna acha hai, larke ko thakana nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041979.what: Yellow Line case mein final charge sheet manzoor — Zameer Abbasi aur ex-directors par Rs8.5bn advance payments baghair bank guarantee ka ilzaam, 2 farar directors ke warrant.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041979.why: Karachi ka BRT project saalon se atka hua hai aur is case mein paisa advance mein de diya gaya — ye sirf corruption ka case nahi, Karachi ke commuters ka case hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041979.next: 23 November ki hearing batayegi ke trial kitni tezi se aage barhta hai — aur kya farar directors giraftar hote hain ya nahi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041979.take: Meri take: Rs8.5 billion advance, baghair guarantee, baghair clause — ye number sun kar hairani nahi hoti, afsos hota hai. Kyun ke ye paisa kisi file ka nahi, Karachi ke us shehri ka hai jo roz ghanton traffic mein phansa rehta hai. Charge sheet manzoor hona pehla qadam hai, aakhri nahi — asal insaf tab hoga jab paisa wapas aaye ya zimmedar saza paye.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041953/cm-mar.what: CM Maryam ne federal minister Salik Hussain ko Rs5bn defamation notice bheja — TV par Punjab mein corruption ke ilzamat par, 7 din mein maafi ya adalat.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041953/cm-mar.why: Ye case sirf do siyasatdanon ki larai nahi — ye sawal hai ke ek minister ke ilzamat par saboot mangna theek hai ya dhamki, aur media par ilzaam lagana kitna mehfooz hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041953/cm-mar.next: 7 din ki deadline mein Salik maafi mangte hain, saboot dete hain, ya case adalat mein jata hai — aur Khawaja Asif ka bayan bhi is kahani ko aage barha raha hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041953/cm-mar.take: Meri take: Maryam ka 'saboot lao warna adalat' wala stance usooli tor par theek hai — ilzaam baghair saboot ke nahi lagna chahiye, chahe lagane wala minister hi kyun na ho. Lekin ye bhi sach hai ke Rs5bn ka notice ek taqatwar signal hai — chhote log isay dekh kar sochenge ke hukumat par tanqeed mehngi par sakti hai. Tanqeed aur ilzaam mein farq hona chahiye, aur ye farq adalat mein hi tay hoga.

mood: 🏛️ Opposition ek table par, 🎓 bachon ka AI off, ⚖️ Rs5bn ka notice — aaj siyasat garam, tech mein bari tabdeeli.
